name: Fog
description: Blurs every attack into a soft cloud with no tail at all: the diffusion of a reverb without the reverb.

params.name: Size
params.description: How long the cloud lasts. Short only softens attacks. Long turns each note into a slow swell. Moving it bends the pitch of what is in the cloud for a moment.

params.name: Density
params.description: How finely the cloud is ground. Low is a spray of separate echoes. High is a smooth wash with no grain.

params.name: Layers
params.description: Sends the cloud through itself again. Each layer makes it longer and later, and rounds its start and end.

params.name: Drift
params.description: Slowly moves the cloud's inner times so a held sound never stands quite still. The longer the cloud, the slower it moves. Too slow and small to hear as pitch.

params.name: Soften
params.description: Turns down the first moment of each note before it is blurred, so the hit itself goes. It works on the dry sound too, as far as Mix is up. Fast repeats are left alone.

params.name: Damp
params.description: Takes the highs out of the cloud. At zero the cloud has every frequency the sound had.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Takes the lows out of the cloud. With some dry sound left in, bass notes stay clear of it. With Mix fully up the lows are gone from the sound.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the cloud spreads to the sides. At zero a mono sound stays in the middle. Summed to mono, every note comes through alike at any setting.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry sound and the cloud. Fully up there is only cloud. Near the middle the two cancel at some pitches and a held note can thin, so keep to the ends.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A chain of Schroeder allpasses with no feedback path around it; no constants or code were taken from any reverb.
